prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A moody, cinematic scene set in a dimly lit workshop or garage, illuminated primarily by a single, bright, cool-toned light source positioned behind a sleek, modern electric motorcycle. The motorcycle, with a minimalist and futuristic design in white and gray tones, stands as the focal point in the center-right of the composition. In the foreground, partially silhouetted, is a person standing with their back to the camera, holding a motorcycle helmet adorned with various stickers. The person is dressed in dark, casual clothing—black pants and black slip-on sneakers with white soles—adding to the understated, urban vibe. The background is cluttered with shelves filled with boxes and mechanical parts, contributing to the authentic, industrial atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by cool blues, grays, and muted blacks, with soft, diffused shadows and subtle highlights creating a sense of depth and intrigue. The overall style is reminiscent of a high-end commercial or a dramatic film still, with a low camera angle and shallow depth of field that draws attention to the motorcycle while keeping the environment immersive and textured. The mood is contemplative and anticipatory, evoking a sense of preparation and focus before a ride.
